newsitem.title: USA: TCC Allen-Lewis unit sees lower margins.
newsitem.headline: TCC Allen-Lewis unit sees lower margins.

text.p: TCC Industries Inc said on Wednesday that its Allen-Lewis Manufacturing Co unit continued to experience lower gross profit margins and a slight increase in selling and administrative expenses.
This caused the unit's results to lag behind last year's results and company expectations, TCC said.

The company also said Thomas LaMaida recently joined Allen-Lewis as vice president of sales and marketing. Management believed LaMaida, who had 20 years of senior sales experience, would make a positive contribution to the company.
The unit continued to make changes within its organization to improve results, TCC said.
